messages.subject: multi-session error with no captures
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to fit a multi-session model where some of the sessions do not have any captures, which I read is possible in the secr-multisession pdf. When I can read in the data as follows:

capdata<-read.capthist("capture_data2_noday3_twosess.csv", "trap_layout2.csv", detector="multi", noncapt="NONE")

I get the following warning which seems correct:
Session 2 
No live releases
Duplicated or missing row names (animal ID)

 but when I use secr.fit I get the following error:

Error in secr.fit(capdata, model = list(D ~ 1, g0 ~ 1, sigma ~ 1), buffer = 1000,  : 
  'verify' found errors in 'capthist' argument

I have also tried a simplified 2 session dataset. The second session (the one with no captures) has a unique session number, NONE for ID and 0 for occasion and detector. When I use the summary function I see that my caphist object is a multi-session object and session 2 did not have any captures which is all correct.

I also have the same problem with the newest version of secr (3.2.1)

I am unclear why I am getting an error with secr.fit?

Thanks,
Alex

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: multi-session error with no captures
parts: Have you tried with verify = FALSE? Bypassing the check may be enough.

Worked perfectly! Thanks Murray - I should have thought to see if there was a way to bypass the warning, but I really appreciate the help!

I ran it with a larger dataset that had 2 missing sessions. Each session had slightly different estimates of density. I am guessing it is because I had session specific encounter files and the one with more occasions did have lower density which makes sense to me. Sound right?
